import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class bubblestrike {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] input = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        int x = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        double prob = Double.parseDouble(input[1]);
        int pos = x;
        for (int a = x; a > 0; a /= 2) {
            while (pos - a >= 0 && check(pos - a, x - (pos - a), prob)) {
                pos -= a;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(pos);
    }
    public static boolean check (int good, int bad, double proba){
        double g = good + 0.0;
        double b = bad + 0.0;
        double ans = (0.25 * b * Math.max(0, b - 1.0) * g + (g * (Math.max(0, g - 1) * Math.max(0, g - 2) / 6.0) + b * 0.5 * (g) * Math.max(0, g - 1))) / ((g + b) * Math.max(0, g + b - 1) * Math.max(0, g + b - 2) / 6.0);
        return ans >= proba;
    }
}
